title: Todoist data breach, Nov 2026

subject.name: Todoist
subject.about: Todoist is a to-do list and task management app made by Todoist Inc., a company that has worked remotely since 2011. It says the app is used by tens of millions of people and teams to organise work and life.

disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Todoist, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Todoist says its app is used by tens of millions of people. About 6% of its users had an email address and an old password hash taken; the company has not given a number of accounts.
who_is_affected: Todoist users whose account still had a password stored the old way (about 6%), and much smaller groups whose tokens, task text or Outlook email previews were taken. Todoist says it has emailed everyone affected; users who got no email need do nothing.

known.text: Todoist says an attacker got into its production systems on Nov 23, 2026, using a stolen credential.
Email addresses, old password hashes and account creation dates for about 6% of users were downloaded.
Smaller groups had tokens, task and comment text, or Outlook email previews taken.
Todoist disabled affected passwords and tokens and emailed affected users.

not_known.text: How the first stolen credential was obtained.
Whether regulators or police have been told.
